security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Splay fills your screen with all your apps when you press Ctrl Alt Space. Arrange them in pages and folders, find any app by typing, do quick sums, and open a whole group of apps with one click. Free and open source, on Windows, macOS and Linux, with nothing sent anywhere.
